description: Defines the ApiClient class that provides methods for interacting with a backend API, including authentication, site management, and workflow operations, with environment-based configuration and retry logic.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods to interact with a backend server, handling authentication, data retrieval, and workflow operations, with retry and error handling.

methods.name: _baseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL from environment variable or defaults.

methods.name: _getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored authentication token from shared preferences.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Generates HTTP headers, including authorization if token exists.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object for API endpoints.

methods.name: _withRetry
methods.description: Executes a network action with retry logic on failures.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login and stores the auth token.

methods.name: getSites
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of sites.

methods.name: getSite
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific site by ID.

methods.name: getSiteVerifications
methods.description: Fetches verifications for a specific site.

methods.name: triggerVerification
methods.description: Triggers verification process for a site.

methods.name: getWorkflowSteps
methods.description: Fetches workflow steps for a site.

methods.name: completeWorkflowStep
methods.description: Marks a workflow step as completed.

methods.name: _throwOnError
methods.description: Throws an exception if the HTTP response indicates an error.
